precision: One candidate per run of at least three edit/write calls in a wake with no spawn/tell, agy-worker or agy-pc launch since the wake began or the last hand-off; bash builds are not counted, and a few-line fix the profile allows may match and requires review.

precision: final text shaped like a memory line (date and id range, machine-notice wording, id+n|), a commitment id restated as waiting on the operator, or a 'nothing new' opening, after a [OptChat heartbeat] prompt and before the next user message; a wake that merely reports work in Portuguese is not counted
